steps.text: 11:10 A.M. \ Clear
Rhodes Island Landship, Cabin No. 2, Operator Living Area

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Breathe in—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: —Breathe out.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Empty your mind. Purge your thoughts.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Alright. No problems.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Heart rate unaccelerated, emotions holding steady. You're alright, Lava. You can do this!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: This is the one! You're gonna talk to Hibiscus without getting pissed at her!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Oh, Lava~! You're just in time!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I've prepared you a healthy meal for today too, so make sure you eat it!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What? For hell's sakes, who'd want to eat your 'healthy meals' day in day out?!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: ...Hfff...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (No, no, Lava. Don't talk to her like this.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Patience. Bring out your will of a master fortune-teller, and control yourself...)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Steady heart. Steady heart.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Uh, no, I mean...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: With every day being healthy meals, I'm a little tired... I'm not saying I'm fed up with you! Don't overthink it!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Haha, what's all that rubbish for? Of course I know you wouldn't be fed up with your sister~

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Come on, this is today's lunch. Make sure you don't leave a single scrap!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's been getting cold lately. Balanced nutrition is the number one defense against getting ill, don't you know?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Blugh...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Hmm? What's wrong?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I've told... I'm TELLING you...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Forget this fff... flavor for a moment. You know the thing I hate eating most is tomatoes, right?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Uh-huh. Why wouldn't I know?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: So why...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: —Why would you go and stuff all this boiled tomato into MY lunch!?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Aw, don't get worked up. It's because tomatoes are very nutritious, of course~

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: And don't think I didn't know! Don't you always sneak any food you don't like onto Kroos's plate?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: And not just that, you've only been eating meat recently, without a single vegetable in sight, haven't you?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You can't be like that, you can't be picky! 'Bad kids' like you who don't listen are in need of a little stricter punishment!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll be watching you to make sure you eat every last bite today!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Don't get angry don't get angry don't get angry.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Don't get... aaaarrrghh fffor gods' sakes I can't do it I can't take this!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Can you stop being like this ever! Don't treat me! Like! A child—!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And it all ends up like this once again.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I didn't want to argue with her, but she's just too annoying, isn't she? Who forces people to eat what they hate like that? Urp... I still feel like I want to throw up a little.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Whatever. It's my fault in the end for not controlling my temper...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: What what what? Who's bullying you?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Tell me quick, I'll beat them up! Just watch me pummel any rotten bully into next week! Just liiiiiiike—this!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Waagh!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Stop swinging your bat around in here! That's dangerous as hell!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hold on, didn't the Doctor say hitting people with your bat was forbidden on the ship? Wasn't writing a whole letter enough to learn anything?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Oh, right! Awgh... I hate writing self reflection letters! I don't wanna write any more!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Oh well, that's okay, I can do it without using my bat. Look, I can smash my backpack into any baddies! My backpack's really useful! Amiya and the bosses said I was really cool and strong!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: So don't worry, Lava, it's my turn to make the baddies learn!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I don't worry about... look, just pause, calm down for now. Mind you don't get dragged in for another lecture.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And nobody's bullying me.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Really.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: (Staring)

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: You're lying!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Wha?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: If nobody's bullying you, then why do you look like you're having a really sad time, Lava?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Sad? Do... do I?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: No way, you're seeing me wrong! I don't—

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Of course you do! I don't see things wrong!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Your eyebrows are all crumpled like that one time you were playing piano and the lid smashed into your hands! You look like you're really hurt!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You're blowing this out of proportion!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Am I right or not!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Fine, okay, you're right. But it's not anything that serious. *sigh* I just had an argument with that stupid Hibiscus, nothing unusual...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Oh, is it a Hibiscus thing again?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Awwww. If it's a Hibiscus thing, then I can't help you out...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Because Hibiscus isn't a baddie, right? She was really nice and gentle last time she examined me, and she gave me a little cake too! It was super tasty!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hmph. That's just like her, playing nice.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What's so amazing about cakes? It's not like I can't make them...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And with HER abilities, baking something that counts as edible these days? Do you have any idea how many times she had to fail before that?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And she couldn't throw away anything she'd ruined, and she forced me to clean up her awful messes for her.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Um... um? I don't get it!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Does that mean you got a lot of cakes to eat?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: As if it'd mean that!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Ugh... forget it. I don't know what I'm doing telling you this.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Basically, if you actually had a brother or sister or whatever, you'd understand what kinds of maddening creatures big sisters are! Especially the oppressive, dictatorial ones like Hibiscus...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hey. What's the silence for?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Um. How do I put this?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I think, it's really nice!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Huh? What part of that's nice?!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: It's really nice, the idea of having a sibling... I really wanna experience it.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I could ask the Doctor to be my brother or sister or something, but, it wouldn't be like it is between you and Hibiscus, right?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Uh, that'd be, I guess... not the same?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Knew it...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Then, Lava.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I thought of a good idea—you just gotta make Hibiscus be my older sister!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Pfff—!!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: *cough*, *cough* *cough* *cough*... Wh—What kind of insane idea is that?!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I'm not being insane, I'm saying it very seriously!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Do you understand that, like, sisters... familial sisters are blood-related? They—Even if you wanted to, they're not something you can just give up to other people!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Whaaa—what does that matter? I don't care if there's no blood or whatever, right?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You still can't!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Can't I really? Pleaaaase—

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: You're always saying Hibiscus is your sworn nemesis, and she's the incarnation of evil thingies, right? So if you don't want your big sister, you can just let me have her!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: That—I...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: No. In one word, no!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: There isn't a why not! No just means no!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Spoilsport!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Say whatever you want!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I don't get it. Whyyy...? Okay...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: But for super real, then, why are you always fighting with Hibiscus, then?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I heard from Fang that when you just joined the squad, and you first saw Hibiscus, you almost said you were gonna quit right there. Is that true?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What's Fang doing telling you all that...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: So it's real?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It's real.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Oh... but that's really weird, 'cause why didn't you know Hibiscus was gonna be in your squad too? Um, didn't you come to Rhodes Island together?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What are you asking for? Where'd all this curiosity of yours come from?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Tell me, tell me!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Don't—Don't shake me... Fine, fine, if I tell you you'll be happy, right? This is doing my head in, but there's not even much to hide anyway.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hibiscus and I did leave home together at first. However, midway, something unexpected occurred...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: As in—*ahem*—I had an argument with her halfway along, so we split up.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: That's not unexpected at all!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Shut up! I know it's not cool at all either!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It was an argument about—uh—I can't remember what it was, forget it... essentially, after we argued I was pissed beyond belief, and ran off to vent some steam, and ended up going a little too far without realizing...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I wasn't too good with telling apart wasteland geography, and I went off any sort of signed road while I was still fuming, so I... just...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Wait, no way? You ran too far away and got lost just like that? Alone in the wasteland?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: More or less. Luckily I came across a caravan afterwards, and they took me up close to Leithanien.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Lava, you...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: You're a huge little dummy—!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: You're a dummy! You're a huge little dummy! How can anyone get so lost they go from Victoria to Leithanien? Ahahahaha—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You're the literal last person I want to hear this from!!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: But my fortune telling didn't miss. It was my fated encounter!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: If I hadn't followed the caravan for Leithanien, I would've never met my teacher, and if he never taught me music, then I'd definitely be having a hard time learning Originium Arts now!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Oh, that's true. You learn Originium Arts really good and fast too...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: The instructors and Pith all say you're great. And the elite operator sir I saw last mission, with the stiff face and the eyes like this, and the weirdly nice voice, he said so too!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Actually, you've been going to the training grounds every day. Is that because you're learning from that operator guy?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Tch. I'd like to be, but when would something that good ever happen?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: How would someone as important as Master Logos ever have the time to teach me specifically? Just the couple of words he gave last time are already amazing enough...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And what was with your description of him just now?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Don't cock your head and play dumb! He's a master, a cool and strong and eye-catching graceful mysterious composed master! You need to have a little more respect towards him!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Wow... I got it, I got it~

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: You really worship that elite operator sir guy, huh...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It's not worship, it's respect! Respect for the strong!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hmph. There'll be a day when I become just as strong as him!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Uh, huuuh...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: (But the look on Lava's face is totally like when all the nice people out at that logistics office last time saw Sora singing...)

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: (Ohh, now I get it! So this is what respect is!)

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: But, you know, I still feel really sorry.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Sorry for what?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Umm... I was thinking, see, if Hibiscus became my big sister, then you'd start calling me a big sister too.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Sorry!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You can dream on! Like hell I would!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And obviously me and Hibiscus are the exact same age! Why's she the big sister and I'm the little one?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Let me make it clear, I'm literally taller than the both of you!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: It's nothing to do with height. Hibiscus is really caring of me, so she's a big sister to me. But I always feel like you're younger than me.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I can't make heads or tails of what you're saying... You mean I don't care for you?!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Awwwwaawa stop puwwing on my face—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hmph. Someone should've taught you this sooner or later.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Remember! Never judge a book by its cover, and especially not when you're in front of a Sarkaz! For a Sarkaz, age and appearance are two separate matters!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Oh! Are you actually like the kind of old lady that looks young instead? Just like Dr. Warfarin?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Not quite.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: You aren't?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Whatever. I shouldn't be talking to you about this.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Actually, don't tell Dr. Warfarin what you just said under any circumstances either. You will 100% be killed.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Let's leave it at that. I still have some things to do, so I'll be heading off.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Ah! Where are you gonna go play, Lava? I wanna come with—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You—are—not! I'm not off to play, and don't you follow me!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I'm going to deal with a few matters...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: No-one's in.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Weird. How late is it? Hibiscus should've come back at this time already...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Honestly. It's all that Cuora's fault with all the weird stuff she spouted.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: ('Let me have your sister.' In what universe? She's not a commodity. How would anyone ever...)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Spoilsport, my ass. If we really could switch and she'd stop being my sister, I'd thank every star in the whole goddamn sky! It's not like I have any choice when it comes to sibling stuff...)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (...For—Forget it.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (I shouldn't have lost my temper over today. Being wrong is being wrong. Nothing I can't recognize there.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (When Hibiscus gets back, I'll apologize to her—)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What is this... Cake—and... a letter?

a.text: To Lava: Your sister's looking after patients in the Medical Department tonight and probably can't make it back, so don't wait for me in the evening! I heard from Instructor Dobermann that you've been really hardworking lately, always paying special attention to practicing your Originium Arts, right? A couple of Caster operators including Pith and that Logos were all complimenting you, saying you've got a natural gift, and you learn extraordinarily well! As your big sister, seeing you so outstanding makes me feel very, truly happy. The only thing is, your sister's a doctor, and from a doctor's perspective, things can also make me worry.

Recently, you've been waking up very early every morning to practice, right? When you stay in the training rooms all morning, sometimes you even forget to eat breakfast, and you rush through your lunch and dinner, your diet is imbalanced. And both as a doctor and your big sister, it's very hard not to feel uneasy about it. Frequent casting of Originium Arts is going to have some effect or other on our conditions, and if we're not careful, the risk will balloon. I know a lot of effort is a good thing, but you need to take care, too. You can't ever neglect your body's health.

What happened at lunch today was your sister's fault. I shouldn't have acted so obstinate while knowing full well you don't like tomatoes. I'm really sorry, Lava. Recently, you've actually been trying to get along with me better, right? That makes me very happy. So, I'll reflect properly on myself too, and strive not to make you upset next time! The cake on the table is a gift of apology. If you can forgive your big sister, go on and give it a taste. I've been secretly practicing for a while by myself, and baked this one specially for you. I'm sure it'll be something you like!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What is she—writing something so—so sympathetic for? Doesn't she get embarrassed?!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: She really is an evil one... just too evil...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: She even apologized first before I could. That's not cool at all...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Takes a big bite of the cake)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Blugh. She put something weird inside it yet again.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And she said she was sure I'd like it... hmph. It's not even sweet enough. Disqualified.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And wouldn't she forget to eat, spending all night busy at Medical? And she tells me I don't take care of my health. She's exactly the same.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Fine, then. In exchange for the cake, I'll need to force myself to go give her something to eat...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Heh. You really are hopeless without me, aren't you, you huge dummy sister.
